```patch
replace CartItemRow/row
  row gap=2 {
    text item.product.name
    button "-" -> onChangeQty(item.product.id, -1)
    text item.qty
    button "+" -> onChangeQty(item.product.id, 1)
    text `$${(item.product.price * item.qty).toFixed(2)}`
    button "Quitar" danger -> onChangeQty(item.product.id, -item.qty)
  }
```

```patch
replace CouponsRow
  row gap=2 {
    text item.name bold
    text `Descuento: ${item.amount}`
    button "Eliminar" danger small
  }
set CouponsRow item: Item onRemove: (id: Number) => void

  button "Eliminar" danger small -> onRemove(item.id)
replace CouponsList/for
  for item in items {

  }
```
